note: Drop Zone games (D-074). Range ball (GolfBallRules): launch speed = club speed x power^power_curve at the club's loft, quadratic drag, backspin lift (decays at spin_decay/s) -> full-power carry ~200 m driver / 180 3 wood / 158 5 iron / 140 m 7 iron / 115 9 iron / 90 m wedge; the swing meter's error (D-086) starts the ball up to swing.max_yaw_deg off line and curves it with sidespin up to swing.max_curve m/s2 (about 27 m of slice on a full driver); first bounce keeps bounce of the vertical and roll_keep of the horizontal speed, then it rolls out at roll_friction m/s2. Targets score where the ball first lands (inner bullseye_frac of the radius x bullseye_mult). Putting: speed = power x max_speed, slowing at decel_green / decel_fringe / decel_sand m/s2; drops into the cup when within cup_r below cup_max_speed; water = +1 stroke, back to the last spot; a hole's optional slope [x, z] (m/s2 downhill) bends putts on the green / fringe; the meter's error pushes a putt up to swing.putt_yaw_deg off line. Swing meter (SwingMeter, D-086): up_s for the bar to fill, down_s to come back (putts: putt_up_s / putt_down_s), accuracy zone below the line, sweet = PERFECT, good = GOOD (half the error), shank = past the zone. course_clubs: the bag on the country club course (putter = putting roll). Pickleball (PickleballRules): rally scoring to win_points (win by win_by), CPU opponent. D-089: a click starts a swing that makes contact windup_s later and needs recovery_s before the next; timing grades by the ball's time to closest approach at contact (perfect_s / good_s, else early / late; reach_m + reach_slack_m or it's a whiff): PERFECT flies flat (perfect_apex_m) and deep and adds ai_miss_perfect to the CPU's miss chance, EARLY is pulled mistime_yaw_deg left and short, LATE pushed right and floats (late_apex_m, the CPU smashes it). Volleys: not the serve or the return (two-bounce rule), not from within kitchen_m of the net. The CPU lobs (lob_apex_m) a player within net_camp_m of the net. callout_s: how long the point callout stays up.
